hypotheses.R0_native_endpoints_are_consistent: Manual native endpoints agree within 1e-4 logits in every held-out cell.
hypotheses.R1_L17H2_boundary_replicates: The discovery-selected L17H2 boundary edge mediates at least 5% of the signed effect and beats the 95th random-contrast percentile in at least four of five held-out cells.
hypotheses.R2_L17_full_destination_replicates: Freezing complete Layer-17 destination attention mediates at least 20% of the signed effect in at least four of five held-out cells.
hypotheses.R3_L11H6_is_weak_not_major: The discovery-selected L11H6 edge stays below 5% mediation in all held-out cells.
hypotheses.R4_boundary_only_is_incomplete_at_L17: Complete Layer-17 destination attention exceeds all Layer-17 boundary edges by at least 0.10 mediation fraction in at least four of five held-out cells.
hypotheses.R5_residual_consumer_is_distributed: R1, R2, R3, and R4 all hold.
